༄༅/ /badz+rabidāraṇānāmadhāraṇaṃbiharatisma/༄༅/ /rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs bzhugs so/gang thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi/ /ra

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /ba dz+ra bi dā ra ṇā nā ma dhā ra ṇaṃ bi ha ra ti sma/༄༅/ /rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs bzhugs so/ gang thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi/ /rdo rje rin chen kun nas 'bar ba'i mthus/ /bdud bzhi'i stobs rnams rnam par 'joms mdzad pa/ /rdo rje rnam par 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra bi dā ra ṇa nā ma dhā ra ṇi/ bod skad du/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje la bzhugs te/ sangs rgyas kyi mthus lag na rdo rje'i lus thams cad rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs nas rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /de nas lag na rdo rjes sangs rgyas kyi mthu dang*/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin gyis rlabs kyis/ rdo rje khro bo las byung ba/ rdo rje'i snying po rab tu smras te/ mi chod pa/ mi shigs pa/ bden pa/ sra ba/ brtan pa/ thams cad du thogs pa med pa/ thams cad du ma pham pa/ sems can thams cad skrag par byed pa/ sems can thams cad 'jil bar byed pa/ rig sngags thams cad gcod par byed pa/ rig sngags thams cad gnon par byed pa/ las thams cad 'joms par byed pa/ gzhan gyi las thams cad 'jig par byed pa/ gdon thams cad brlag par byed pa/ gdon thams cad las thar bar byed pa/ 'byung po thams cad 'gugs par byed pa/ rig sngags kyi las thams cad byed du 'jug pa/ ma grub pa rnams grub par byed pa/ grub pa rnams chud mi za bar byed pa/ 'dod pa thams cad rab tu sbyin pa/ sems can thams cad bsrung ba/ zhi ba/ rgyas pa/ sems can thams cad rengs par byed pa/ rmugs par byed pa'i gsang sngags kyi mthu chen po 'di/ sangs rgyas kyi mthus lag na rdo rjes rab tu smras so/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/

na mash+tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa ta ye/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ tru ṭa tru ṭa/ tro tra ya tro tra ya/ s+phu ṭa s+phu ṭa/ s+pho ṭa ya s+pho ṭa ya/ ghūr+ṇa ghūr+ṇa/ ghūr+ṇa pa ya ghūr+ṇa pa ya/ sarba sa twā ni/ bo dha ya bo dha ya/ saṃ bo dha ya saṃ bo dha ya/ bh+ra ma bh+ra ma/ saṃ bh+rā ma ya saṃ bh+rā ma ya/ sarba bhū tā ni/ kuṭ+ṭa kuṭ+ṭa/ saṃ kuṭ+ṭa ya saṃ kuṭ+ṭa ya/ sarba sha trūn/ gha ṭa gha ṭa/ saṃ gha ṭa ya saṃ gha ṭa ya/ sarba bid+yāṃ badz+ra badz+ra/ s+pho ṭa ya badz+ra badz+ra/ ka ṭa badz+ra badz+ra/ ma ṭa badz+ra badz+ra/ ma tha badz+ra badz+ra/ aṭ+ṭa ha sa nī la badz+ra su badz+rā ya swā hā/ he phul+lu/ ni ru phul+lu/ gṛ h+ṇa kul+lu/ mi li tsul+lu/ badz+ra bi dza yā ya swā hā/ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya swā hā/ ka ṭa ka ṭa/ ma ṭa ma ṭa/ ra ṭa ra ṭa/ mo ṭa nā pra mo ṭa nā ya swā hā/ tsa ra ni tsa ra/ ha ra ha ra/ sa ra sa ra/ mā ra ya/ badz+ra bi dā ra ṇa ya swā hā/ ts+tshin+da ts+tshin+da/ bhin+da bhin+da/ ma hā badz+ra kī li kī lā ya swā hā/ ban+dha ban+dha/ kro dha ma hā kī li kī lā ya swā hā/ tsu ru tsu ru/ tsaṇ+ḍa kī li kī lā ya swā hā/ trā sa ya trā sa ya/ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya swā hā/ ha ra ha ra/ badz+ra dha rā ya swā hā/ pra ha ra pra ha ra/ badz+ra pra bhañdza nā ya swā hā/ ma ti s+thi ra badz+ra/ shru ti s+thi ra badz+ra/ pra ti s+thi ra badz+ra/ ma hā badz+ra/ a pra ti ha ta badz+ra/ a mo gha badz+ra/ eh+ye hi badz+ra/ shrī gh+raṃ badz+ra dha rā ya swā hā/ dha ra dha ra/ dhi ri dhi ri/ dhu ru dhu ru/ sarba badz+ra ku la mā warta ya swā hā/

a mu kaṃ gnod byed dgra bgegs 'byung po thams cad mā ra ya phaṭa/ na maḥs man+ta badz+rā ṇāṃ/ sarba badz+ra ku la mā' brta ya/ ma hā ba le/ ka ṭa be/ ta ta le/ a tsa le/ maṇ+ḍa la mā ye/ a ti badz+ra/ ma hā ba le/ be ga ra ṇa ra ṇa/ a dzi te/ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ ti ṭi ti ṭi/ piṅga le/ da ha da ha/ te dzo ba ti/ ti li ti li/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ma hā ba le/ badz+ra aṅku sha dz+wā lā ya swā hā/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mash+tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa ta ye/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ ha ra ha ra badz+ra/ ma tha ma tha badz+ra/ dhu na dhu na badz+ra/ da ha da ha badz+ra/ pa tsa pa tsa badz+ra/ dha ra dha ra badz+ra/ dhā ra ya dhā ra ya badz+ra/ dā ru ṇa dā ru ṇa badz+ra/ ts+tshin+dha ts+tshin+dha badz+ra/ bhin+da bhin+da badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ na mash+tsan+ḍa badz+ra kro dhā ya/ hu lu hu lu/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ bhan+dha bhan+da/ ha na ha na/ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ sdig pa thams cad byang byas nas/ /sdug bsngal thams cad med par byed/ /rgyud do cog gi rtsa ba ste/ /dpal kun gyis ni legs par brgyan/ /sems can dbang po nyams pa dang*/ /tshe zad pa dang tshe nyams dang*/ /phun sum tshogs min gang chags dang*/ /lha rnams rgyab kyis phyogs pa dang*/ /mdza' sdug skye bo sdang ba dang*/ /bran bza' la sogs gtses pa dang*/ /phan tshun mthun pa ma yin dang*/ /nor 'grib pas ni gnod pa dang*/ /mya ngan ngal dang gnod pa dang*/ /'jigs pa dang ni phongs pa dang*/ /gza' dang rgyu skar byad stems dang*/ /mi bzad gdon kyis nyen pa dang*/ mya ngan ngal las byung ba yi/ /rmi lam sdig pa mthong na yang*/ /des ni rab bkrus gtsang ma yis/ /mdo sde dam pa nyan par gyis/ /gang dag yid dge sems dwangs zhing*/ /gtsang ma'i gos kyis rab brgyan te/ /zab mo sangs rgyas spyod yul ba/ /mdo sde 'di ni nyan byed na/ /mdo sde 'di yi bzi brjid kyis/ /srog chags dag ni thams cad kyi/ /mi bzad pa yi nad rnams kyang*/ /de dag thams cad zhi bar blta/ /tshe dang bsod nams 'phel bar 'gyur/

/sdig pa kun las rnam par thar/ /nor bu yungs kar dūrba dang*/ /rin chen rma med tsan+dan bcas/ /shel dang rdo rje me tog dang*/ /chu yis gser ram yang na ni/ /dngul gyi bum pa dag kyang rung*/ /gtsang ma'i gos kyis dkri zhing dgang*/ /lan grangs nyi shu rtsa gcig gam/ /yang na lan grangs brgya rtsa brgyad/ /rdo rje rnam 'joms bzlas nas ni/ /rgyal po rtag tu khrus gyis shig /rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs rdzogs so/ /rgya gar gyi mkhan po shrī lak+ṣ+mī ka ra dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba shong ston rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba'o/ dus phyis dbang lo blo gros brtan pas rgya dpe dag pa rnams dang*/ rgya 'grel bzang po rnams kyi 'bru sbyor dang mthun par bcos te shin tu dag par bgyis pa'o/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags ni/ na maḥs man+ta kā ya wāk+tsit+ta badz+rā ṇāṃ/ na mo badz+ra kro dhā ya/ ma hā daṃṣ+tot+ka ṭa bhai ra wā ya/ a si mu sa la/ pa ra shu pā sha ha stā ya/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li/ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ hu lu hu lu/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ gar+dzha gar+dzha/ bi s+pho ṭa ya bi s+pho ṭa ya/ sarba bigh+nan bi nā ya kā na/ ma hā ga ṇa pa ti dzī wi tān+ta ka rā ya swā hā/ zhes so/ /bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zhi ba dang*/ /mi mthun gnod pa'i rkyen dang bral ba dang*/ /'dod pa 'grub cing phun sum tshogs pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /sarba dā maṅga laṃ// //
